title: WRATH: Aeon of Ruin
provenance: Reported by Swiss-Mac-User (highball-db#571, 2026-10-19), Apple M5 Pro, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.21, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, DXVK, sync off, rated 5 of 5 after 19 minutes: almost straight 120 fps, with short hitches when new sprites or effects load and some drops in larger areas. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on DXVK with the default engine, close to 120 fps on an M5 Pro, with short hitches the first time new effects load. A native build of the game's engine for Apple silicon and Intel Macs exists at Mac Source Ports (https://www.macsourceports.com/game/wrath). It runs with the game files from a Steam or GOG copy, without achievements (Swiss-Mac-User, highball-db#571).
